mentions.name: DocuView
mentions.description: DocuView is a real estate software product built as an opinionated alternative to other players in the space. It focuses on the features the builders themselves want, rather than a generalized product where users only use a fraction of the functionality.
mentions.problem: Existing products in the real estate space tend to fit everyone but deliver features that users only partially use ("every user only uses 20% of").
mentions.source_excerpt:
I quit my job a year ago to launch https://docuview.ai.

It’s been sort of a whiplash experience, but ive been so much happier building this business than I was working.

Real estate is a space that’s very close to me, so I was able to see the demand for a product like this long before I went searching for it.
mentions.author: traviswingo
